reply_text:
Pree, it's ticket #8841. I've replied in the #central-random thread.

Tobias posted in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27) that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he had flagged it to support on #8841. He found it while checking the Plains depots on his dealer account. Tobias's post doesn't name the account, but a Central team digest from January calls Marrow Fieldworks "Pree's dealer account" and says it changed hands on 5 Jan, so it looks like Marrow Fieldworks.

In the reply I also told Pree not to confuse it with #88412, which is the old Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 scanner ticket.
